title: Requirement 'Payment DR' declares RPO 15 min but datastore 'sql-pay-prod' lacks replica or failover properties
rationale: Linked datastore 'sql-pay-prod' does not declare geo-replica, failover group, or equivalent recovery topology for RPO 15 min.
decisionsTaken: Parsed recovery objective on requirement without matching replica declaration on linked datastore.

title: Workload-conditioned requirement themes are incomplete
rationale: Scope metadata was not stored on the context snapshot; expected requirement themes use the engine baseline default (traceability, availability) plus any policy-stamped themes — not workload-conditioned scope signals.
decisionsTaken: Compared workload-conditioned requirement themes to themes inferred from requirement nodes.

title: Requirement detected: Payment DR
rationale: A requirement node exists and must be reflected in the resolved architecture.
decisionsTaken: Linked requirement to the sole in-scope topology resource (single-topology fallback).

title: Workload security baseline control-family coverage is incomplete

title: Category-scoped security baseline coverage is incomplete

title: Topology coverage is incomplete
